name: ingle-plugin-issues
description: Issues: a durable work record shared by people and agents, with states, links, a timeline and FTS search.

issues.title: Issues
issues.description: Issues with editable states, sub-issues, links, a timeline and search. Comments, state and assignee changes wake the owning thread.

tool-issues.title: Issue tools
tool-issues.description: The model-facing issue tool: create, read and update. Coordinators and Captains get it; delegated threads leave it out.

tool-issue-comment.title: Issue comments
tool-issue-comment.description: The issue_comment tool, so any conversation, delegated threads included, can report on an issue.
